hypotheses.justification: Use `omit [DecidableEq G] in`: the existing proof still works unchanged. The definition of Tr uses only Fintype enumeration and finite summation, neither requiring decidable equality. Equiv.mulLeft and Fintype.sum_equiv likewise require no DecidableEq instance. The reindexing argument also works for the trivial group and zero ring; an empty group is excluded by Group.
